extraction.Name: Luther Arcoren
extraction.NOTES: Document is a sworn statement by William J. Bordeaux, age 44, regarding Luther Arcoren (allotment 1196). Bordeaux states he took a contract for deed from Arcoren in favor of himself and W. H. Tackett; after court proceedings in 1920, acting on Tackett's instructions, he executed a quit claim deed freeing Arcoren from any claim. Ella McHenry paid Bordeaux $500 to execute an instrument to clear the land, to be deducted from proceeds Arcoren should receive for the sale of his land to McHenry. Subscribed and sworn before a Notary Public on June 17, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32.
